x: Otherwise, the jumps were generally decimated by injury with the exception of the high jump where Warren Caswell leapt a season's best of 2.15 metres to get close to Dalton Grant.

It was a great afternoon for the British as well, started by high jumper Dalton Grant of Haringey. Cheerfully acknowledging our support he played a waiting game, passing at British record height, then setting a Commonwealth Record but so narrowly missing the medals.

Qualifying round. 30 Aug. 16:40; pool 1; qual. 2.30 or 12; temp. 27C; humidity 78%. =1, C.Austin (USA), M.Drake (CUB), D.Grant (GBR) 2.27; ... 19, R.Te Puni (NZL) 2.15 (2.05-1, 2.10-1, 2.15-3, 2.20-f).
Jon Ridgeon gained a fine second to carry on his gruelling race schedule over the high hurdles while Ian Wells again stepped in to pip Dalton Grant (yes - Dalton Grant!) in the 'B' hurdles.
Haringey's Dalton Grant is a fine ambassador for our sport and we have him to thank - although he probably doesn't know it - for the re-launching of the athletic career of Julia Cockram.

Left: Richard Hunter made his debut for Belgrave on September 7th 1991 at New River Stadium, Haringey, placing 2nd in the 'B' 110m hurdles in a legal pb of 15.04. He also clocked 49.96 in the 'B' 400m. Sharing a joke behind him are Belgrave's Ian Wells and Haringey's Dalton Grant.
